source:
(actor domain
  (interface (input request (domain io)) (input allow (domain io)) (input datain (width 3) (domain io)) (input other (width 3) (domain io)) (output seen (width 3) (domain io)) (output done (domain io)))
  (proc choose (params (c (width 1)) (v (width 3)) (alt (width 3)) (out dst (width 3))) (cond (c (set dst v)) (else (set dst alt))))
  (clock-domains (domain idle (clock idle_clk) :default) (domain io (clock clk) (reset (rst_n sync active_low))))
  (transaction main (domain io) (on request) (call choose allow datain other seen) (complete done)))
